iterations.name: Cover
iterations.description: A small bookshop window, led by the cover.
iterations.rationale: Give the illustrated hardback room to breathe. Keep the author, price and purchase action close together beneath it.

iterations.name: Literary · Newsreader
iterations.description: A literary serif with a lighter, more open rhythm.
iterations.rationale: Try Newsreader on the heading for a quieter editorial voice. Its finer details make the title feel closer to a page of print; the card layout, size and weight remain the same.

iterations.name: Modern · Geist
iterations.description: A clean sans serif with a more direct tone.
iterations.rationale: Try Geist on the heading to make the title feel more immediate and contemporary. It loses the literary serif texture while retaining the same card layout, size and weight.

iterations.name: Soft · Fraunces
iterations.description: A rounded display serif with more character.
iterations.rationale: Try Fraunces on the heading for a warmer, more expressive title. Its rounded shapes give the book more personality while the card layout, size and weight stay the same.

iterations.name: Editorial
iterations.description: A reading recommendation with a little book in the margin.
iterations.rationale: Develop Cover into a more compact editorial card. Bring the title and description forward and reduce the cover to a small illustration in the margin.

iterations.name: Night edition
iterations.description: A quiet recommendation for the late hours.
iterations.rationale: Take Cover in a darker direction. A smaller illustration and a pale book jacket keep the same hierarchy while making the card feel at home in an evening reading list.
